excerpt: Aleksandër Moisiu University invites students of the Journalism and Public Relations, Public Relations and Public Communication, in Bachelor's and Master's degree programs can apply to become part of the pilot course; Data Journalism. The course is divided into very interesting modules such as: data discovery, data analysis, data visualization and data journalism and storytelling. Students must have good knowledge of the English language. The course will take place on the dates: May 6-10, 2024 in online form May 20-24, 2024, in Tirana, near UET Applications are open until March 5, 2024. Please apply by clicking on the link below: https://forms.gle/nakvFgNGA1GZy2NC9 We invite you to become part of this challenge and share your passion for journalism and data work. For further information, please contact Ms. Belina Bedini at e-mail address: belina.bedini@uamd.edu.al.
